hints.content: Multiples are numbers that result when we multiply one whole number by another whole number.

We want to find multiples of $\greenD{6}$.

$\begin{align}
\greenD{6}\times1=6\\\\
\greenD{6}\times2=12\\\\
\greenD{6}\times3=18\\\\
\greenD{6}\times4=24\\\\
\greenD{6}\times5=30\\\\
\greenD{6}\times6=36
\end{align}$

question.content:
**Which of the following shows only multiples of $6$?**
